label: Mediport Pocket · public source release
changes: Public self-contained source, tests and contribution guidelines are available on GitHub.
Verified public NTUH formulary pages may be linked as online sources; captured internal records remain excluded.
Install from a shared HTTPS link without Tailscale or an app store.
Calculators, portable guides, drug references and licensed POCUS teaching media download for offline use.
Hospital catalog records, saved local regimens and guides containing captured hospital material are omitted from this edition.
ECG illustrations without recorded reuse provenance are omitted; the text-based reading workflow remains available.
